{Valhalla's} {Fountain}

You fill a flask with water from the fountain.
Now you have three doses of {Berserker} {Potion}.

This potion increases Attack and Luck while equipped, but prevents the drinker from casting spells in combat.

Equip the flask before a battle to use one dose. Keep it in your backpack to save the potion.
The waters of Valhalla refill your Berserker Potion to three doses on every visit.
